note: Mostly seasonal: the operator prefers seasonal leases and says short stays are limited. Small campground on the west shore of Fox Lake about 2 miles north of Sherburn; the four lakeside sites sit beside the docks on the east side of the point. Kayaks and bikes for guest use. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: 17 sites, 30/50 A + sewer (water on full-hookup sites), $40 nightly / $50 lakefront with dock (2024 page), first-come, call to arrange. Long-stay in character ('Seasonal leases preferred! Short term stays are limited.') but passes the five tests. Lakefront kept on the four lakeside sites (sold nightly at $50). Google 4.3/29. Season year_round left (pages conflict). Pin ~105 m from the sites, OK. Phone and website confirmed.
flags: Long-stay five tests (private, mostly seasonal in character: 'Seasonal leases preferred! Short term stays are limited.'; 'ideally suited for your home away from home'; 'Seasonal and year-round visitors may add decks and storage buildings.'): (1) price $40 a night, $50 lakefront, under the US$50 gate with no gateway needed; (2) nights for sale: the operator's own rates page posts 'Nightly $40 per night' and the site gives a phone, with no application, lease, waitlist or membership for a night (just 'Call to confirm availability and make arrangements to pay'); (3) no minimum stay stated; (4) no count of nightly vs seasonal sites anywhere (passes); (5) an RV campground, no homes or lots sold. Passes all five; kept, with the note saying it is mostly seasonal. Google 'Caven's Landing' 4.3 from 29 reviews; RV Life 4*/$$ (stored). Presence: working website with phone 507-822-0646 + Google listing. Reviewer may judge it on the fence: the operator's words say short stays are limited.

Waterfront: keep lakefront, with a caveat that it is the four lakeside sites. Operator: 'Four are lakeside with dock options.' and 'Lakefront with a private dock and full hookups are $50 per night' (a nightly rate, so these sites are sold by the night). Imagery shows campers in the open sand clearing on the east side of the point at about 43.67523,-94.73140 and 43.67509,-94.73137, 15-35 m from Fox Lake over open sand and grass with docks at about 43.67505,-94.73100. Site numbers are not published.

Season: stored year_round true (derived) left alone. The home page says 'daily, weekly, seasonal and year-round camping options', but the rates page sells seasonal sites 'May through October' and 'Off-season Winterize your camper and store November through May. $300.' Whether nights are sold in winter is not stated; the reviewer may clear year_round.

Dock note: the stored note said 'docks/kayaks/bikes for guest use', but the rates page charges 'Dock Rental $250 1/2 dock $500 permanent private'; 'docks' dropped from the guest-use line. Kayaks and bikes are not mentioned on the pages read (kept as written).

Pin 43.6743,-94.7307 sits by the houses south-east of the campground, about 105 m from the lakeside campers at 43.6752,-94.7314; Google's point 43.67498,-94.73341 is about 160 m west in the trees. Under 250 m; OK (a move to 43.6752,-94.7314 is optional).
Phone 507-822-0646 matches the operator site and Google. Website https://cavenslandingcampground.com/ working (copyright 2022, home page modified 2025-06-20, rates page modified 2024-06-03).
